# Forage Canada

> A free guide to wild food in Canada: which wild plants are in season in each province and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 20 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Nettle, Ortie. In season April to July.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Dandelion, Pissenlit. In season April to November.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Chickweed, Mouron des oiseaux. In season April to December.
- [Lamb's quarters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/lambsquarters/): Chenopodium album; Lamb's quarters, Chénopode blanc. In season June to October.
- [Purslane](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/purslane/): Portulaca oleracea; Purslane, Pourpier. In season July to October.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis stricta; Yellow wood sorrel, Oxalide. In season May to November.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Garlic mustard, Alliaire. In season April to July.
- [Ramps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/ramps/): Allium tricoccum; Ramps, Ail des bois. In season May to June.
- [Wild onion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/wildonion/): Allium canadense; Wild onion, Ail du Canada. In season April to July.
- [Broadleaf plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/plantain/): Plantago major; Plantain, Plantain. In season May to October.
- [Common blue violet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/violet/): Viola sororia; Violet, Violette. In season April to June.
- [Ostrich fern fiddleheads](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/fiddlehead/): Matteuccia struthiopteris; Fiddleheads, Têtes de violon. In season May to June.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Watercress, Cresson. In season April to November.
- [Curly dock](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/curlydock/): Rumex crispus; Curly dock, Patience crépue. In season April to July.
- [Sheep sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/sheepsorrel/): Rumex acetosella; Sheep sorrel, Petite oseille. In season May to October.
- [Cattail](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/cattail/): Typha latifolia; Cattail, Quenouille. In season May to August.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/spruce/): Picea; Spruce tips, Pousses d'épinette. In season June to July.
- [Wild asparagus](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/asparagus/): Asparagus officinalis; Wild asparagus, Asperge sauvage. In season May to July.
- [Miner's lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/minerslettuce/): Claytonia perfoliata; Miner's lettuce, Claytonie perfoliée. In season March to June.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/blackberry/): Rubus allegheniensis; Blackberry, Mûre. In season July to September.
- [Black raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/blackraspberry/): Rubus occidentalis; Black raspberry, Framboise noire. In season June to July.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria virginiana; Wild strawberry, Fraise des champs. In season May to July.
- [Serviceberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/serviceberry/): Amelanchier; Serviceberry, Amélanchier. In season June to July.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus canadensis; American elder, Sureau. In season August to September.
- [Wild blueberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/blueberry/): Vaccinium angustifolium; Lowbush blueberry, Bleuet. In season July to August.
- [Huckleberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/huckleberry/): Vaccinium membranaceum; Black huckleberry, Airelle. In season July to September.
- [Salmonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/salmonberry/): Rubus spectabilis; Salmonberry, Ronce remarquable. In season May to July.
- [Thimbleberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/thimbleberry/): Rubus parviflorus; Thimbleberry, Ronce parviflore. In season July to August.
- [Chokecherry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/chokecherry/): Prunus virginiana; Chokecherry, Cerise à grappes. In season August to September.
- [Crabapple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/crabapple/): Malus; Crabapple, Pommetier. In season September to November.
- [Wild grape](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/wildgrape/): Vitis riparia; Riverbank grape, Vigne des rivages. In season August to October.
- [Wild cranberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/cranberry/): Vaccinium macrocarpon; American cranberry, Canneberge. In season September to October.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/rosehip/): Rosa; Wild rose, Cynorrhodon. In season September to December.
- [Staghorn sumac](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/sumac/): Rhus typhina; Staghorn sumac, Vinaigrier. In season August to September.
- [Oregon grape](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/oregongrape/): Mahonia aquifolium; Oregon grape, Mahonia. In season July to September.
- [Black walnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/blackwalnut/): Juglans nigra; Black walnut, Noyer noir. In season September to October.
- [Shagbark hickory](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/hickory/): Carya ovata; Shagbark hickory, Caryer ovale. In season September to October.
- [Acorns](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/acorn/): Quercus; Acorn, Gland. In season September to November.
- [American hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus americana; Hazelnut, Noisetier. In season August to September.
- [Beechnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/beechnut/): Fagus grandifolia; American beech, Faîne. In season September to October.
- [Jerusalem artichoke](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/sunchoke/): Helianthus tuberosus; Sunchoke, Topinambour. In season November to April.
- [Burdock root](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/burdock/): Arctium minus; Burdock, Bardane. In season May to November.
- [Groundnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/groundnut/): Apios americana; Groundnut, Apios d'Amérique. In season October to May.
- [Wapato](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/wapato/): Sagittaria latifolia; Wapato, Sagittaire. In season October to January.
- [Camas](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/camas/): Camassia quamash; Camas, Camassie. In season July to October.
- [Chicory](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/chicory/): Cichorium intybus; Chicory, Chicorée. In season April to December.
- [Wild rice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/wildrice/): Zizania palustris; Manoomin, Riz sauvage. In season August to September.
- [Maple sap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/maple/): Acer saccharum; Sugar maple, Eau d'érable. In season February to March.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus canadensis; Elder blossom, Fleur de sureau. In season June to August.
- [Wild bergamot](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/bergamot/): Monarda fistulosa; Bee balm, Monarde fistuleuse. In season July to September.
- [Linden flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/linden/): Tilia americana; Basswood, Tilleul. In season July to August.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Red clover, Trèfle rouge. In season June to October.
- [Daylily](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/daylily/): Hemerocallis fulva; Orange daylily, Hémérocalle. In season July to August.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Partridgeberry, Airelle vigne-d'Ida. In season August to October.
- [Cloudberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/cloudberry/): Rubus chamaemorus; Bakeapple, Chicouté. In season July to August.
- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Blackberry (NL), Camarine noire. In season August to September.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Sea buckthorn, Argousier. In season August to October.
- [Labrador tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/labradortea/): Rhododendron groenlandicum; Labrador tea, Thé du Labrador. In season all year round.

## Dishes

- [Labrador tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/labrador-tea/): A few leaves steeped weak, sweetened with a little maple syrup.
- [Maple water](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/maple-water/): Fresh maple sap drunk cold in sugaring season.
- [Sumac lemonade](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/sumac-lemonade/): Sumac clusters steeped in cold water, strained and sweetened.
- [Spruce tip syrup soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/spruce-tip-syrup-soda/): Spruce tip syrup with sparkling water.
- [Fiddleheads with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/fiddleheads-with-butter/): Boiled fiddleheads sautéed in butter, the New Brunswick spring dish.
- [Pickled ramps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pickled-ramps/): Ramp bulbs in a spiced vinegar brine.
- [Partridgeberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/partridgeberry-jam/): Tart Newfoundland partridgeberries cooked with sugar.
- [Cranberry sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/cranberry-sauce/): Wild cranberries simmered with maple syrup.
- [Crab apple jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/crab-apple-jelly/): Crab apples simmered, strained and set.
- [Wild rice and mushroom pilaf](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-rice-and-mushroom-pilaf/): Manoomin with mushrooms and herbs, from Ontario and Manitoba lakes.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops with potato and onion, blended.
- [Camas pit bake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/camas-pit-bake/): Camas bulbs slow-cooked until sweet, after Coast Salish and Nlaka'pamux tradition.
- [Bannock with saskatoons](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/bannock-with-saskatoons/): Pan bread studded with saskatoon berries.
- [Wild blueberry muffins](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-blueberry-muffins/): Muffins packed with small wild blueberries.
- [Saskatoon berry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/saskatoon-berry-pie/): The Prairies' signature pie.
- [Blueberry grunt](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/blueberry-grunt/): Nova Scotian stewed blueberries topped with dumplings.
- [Bakeapple jam on toutons](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/bakeapple-jam-on-toutons/): Cloudberry jam on fried bread dough, Newfoundland style.
- [Maple taffy (tire d'érable)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/maple-taffy/): Hot maple syrup poured on snow and rolled onto a stick.
- [Pouding chômeur with maple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pouding-ch-meur-with-maple/): Quebec cake baked in maple syrup sauce.
- [Huckleberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/huckleberry-crumble/): Mountain huckleberries under an oat crumble.
